Name: Better Mushroom Box
Author: po0pfart
Description:
Players choose mushroom option for life elixir but some just rarely spawn making it unreliable. This mod lets player set the spawn rate, duration, number of stacks, quality and type and number of experience from start game setting.

It helps getting stardrop and calico egg rating faster during early game. Skull cavern opens during desert festival and monsters are not yet buffed before obtaining skull key making it easier to obtain iridium ores.

Those who choose mushroom box option but want fruits to spawn in similar way to fruit bat option no need to change cave type, go to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33828]Better Fruit Bat Cave[/url] and download the mod from optional tab, not the main tab.

Check out my other QoL mods too!
